question: What prompt-bearing Markdown validation contract should OpenClaw enforce across workspace bootstrap files, SKILL.md loading, skill install/update, and ClawHub publish/tag flows?
rationale: The remaining work defines security policy for model-visible content and install/publish trust decisions, so automation should not choose the permanent rules, severity levels, override model, or blocking/tagging behavior.

options.title: Define Shared Contract First
options.body: Approve one rule set, severity model, override policy, and tagging/blocking contract before implementing it across core prompt ingestion, skill loading, install/update, and ClawHub publish checks.

options.title: Land Scanner Subset First
options.body: Use the open scanner PR as a narrow first step while explicitly tracking bootstrap, runtime SKILL.md reads, install/update, and ClawHub publish-policy follow-up work.

options.title: Limit To ClawHub Policy
options.body: Keep local prompt-bearing Markdown trusted for now and enforce only publish/install warnings or tags through ClawHub policy.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Contract First
recommendation.body: Approve one rule set, severity model, override policy, and tagging/blocking contract before implementing it across core prompt ingestion, skill loading, install/update, and ClawHub publish checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He already scoped the issue and has the strongest recent history across the implicated prompt, workspace, loader, and scanner paths.
